publishers.name: Aokie
publishers.note: Aokie release bundles, minted 2026-07-12 with crates/package-signer in the Aokie repository. The private half is in Aokie's release pipeline (AOKIE_PACKAGE_SIGNING_KEY) and the operator's offline key file, never in a repository. This public half is published in Aokie's SECURITY.md and was pinned by FormLogic Desktop's retired verifier. It verifies the signature of a real Aokie release manifest, kept as plugins/fixtures/aokie-0.1.0.package-manifest.json and checked by a test.
